variables.name: BookToMarket
variables.definition: The firm's book value of equity divided by its market value of equity, measured at the start of the year.

variables.name: AnnualReturn
variables.definition: The stock's total return over the twelve months following the start of the year.

variables.name: Leverage
variables.definition: The firm's total debt divided by its market value of equity, measured at the start of the year.

variables.name: EarningsSurprise
variables.definition: How far the firm's reported earnings during the year differ from analysts' forecasts.

variables.name: QualityScore
variables.definition: A composite score of the firm's profitability, growth and safety (low leverage, low stock beta estimated from the stock's returns, and stable profitability), measured at the end of the year.

variables.name: PastFiveYearReturn
variables.definition: The stock's total return over the five years before the start of the year.

variables.name: ValueIndexMember
variables.definition: Whether the stock is assigned to a value style index at the start of the year.

variables.name: MarketReturn
variables.definition: The value-weighted average return of all other US stocks, excluding this firm, over the same twelve months as AnnualReturn.

variables.name: InstOwnershipChange
variables.definition: The change in the share of the firm's stock held by institutional investors over the twelve months after the end of the year.

variables.name: FiscalYearEndMonth
variables.definition: The calendar month in which the firm's fiscal year ends.
